deadline.value: International applicants should apply for the Fall semester by February 1; the Graduate School table lists April 1 for Chemistry.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for the Fall semester of each year is February 1st for international students

also.quote: Chemistry - PhD 14-Week URI Grad Application April 1

app_fee.value: The FAQ gives a $35 subsidized fee for Fall 2026 only; the Fall 2027 fee is not stated.
app_fee.quote: The subsidized application fee is $35 for applications to the Fall 2026 semester

fee_waiver.value: The department does not expect to provide full application fee waivers this year.
fee_waiver.quote: We do not expect to be able to provide full application fee waivers this year

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE for any applicant.
gre_general.quote: Please note that we do not require the GRE

gre_subject.value: The FAQ says the department does not require the GRE, so no Chemistry subject test is needed.
gre_subject.quote: Do you require the GRE? | No, we do not

supervisor.value: No faculty agreement is needed before applying; students have most of the first semester before joining a group.
supervisor.quote: No, not at all. In fact, students rarely settle on a research group before they arrive

funding.value: Full-time students get assistantships covering tuition, health insurance and a stipend; external support is only needed for a terminal M.S.
funding.quote: All our full-time graduate students receive support from the Department of Chemistry through assistantships

entry_route.value: A master's degree is not needed; most incoming PhD students have only undergraduate degrees.
entry_route.quote: Absolutely not! Some of our students begin with M.S. degrees from other programs, but the majority of our incoming Ph.D. students only have undergraduate degrees

notes: The department FAQ sets its own application fee and waiver statements for Fall 2026; both are for that cycle only.
